fixes.explanation: Right on the money, baker. The LORD says, "…the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there." (Exodus 8:22) He calls it special treatment. Flies in the palace, flies in the houses, flies on the ground, and Goshen gets none. I once had to share a drawer with dead batteries, and even they didn't buzz at me.

problems.problem: A quiet afternoon in Goshen adds a time and condition the passage does not give.
The junk drawer joke compares dust to an unclear quantity and does not connect to the flies in a way that clicks.
